extracted.name: Cherry Pretzel Dessert
extracted.description: This cherry pretzel dessert features a crunchy crust layered with sweetened cream cheese and canned cherry pie filling for a sweet and salty dessert.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®), thawed
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Mix together pretzels, melted butter, and sugar in a medium bowl; press into the bottom of a 13x9-inch baking dish.
Bake crust in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. Remove to cool completely.
Stir together cream cheese and confectioners' sugar in a large bowl. Fold in whipped topping until smooth. Spread over cooled crust. Cover evenly with cherry pie filling.
